LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Universe in P.name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Universe in Peril
LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Universe in P.summary:
A port of Lego Marvel Super Heroes, a 2013 Lego-themed action-adventure video based on Marvel comic book character.

The game's storyline sees various heroes from the Marvel Universe joining forces to foil the schemes of Doctor Doom and Loki, who have also recruited several villains to aid them, and seek to conquer the Earth using the Doom Ray of Doom, a device built from the shards of the Silver Surfer's board called "Cosmic Bricks".

Mystery Case Files - Ravenhearst.name: Mystery Case Files: Ravenhearst
Mystery Case Files - Ravenhearst.summary: The recently acquired diary of Emma Ravenhearst may hold the key to unraveling the tale behind Ravenhearst Manor, yet pages are missing. Locate and assemble diary pages to unlock the mystery.

Tetris Ultimate.name: Tetris Ultimate
Tetris Ultimate.summary: Tetris Ultimate has six exciting modes, fun new features, and unique visuals, the evolution of this iconic game is the ultimate must-have on next-gen consoles.

Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon - Shadow Wars.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Shadow Wars
Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon - Shadow Wars.summary: Build, train, and equip the ultimate elite special ops team using the latest in high-tech weapons and gear. From the hot deserts of Kazakhstan to the towns and villages of Ukraine and the frozen lands of Siberia, you must discover and disable the secret Soviet-era "Dead Hand" bases which Russian ultranationalist Yuri Treskayev is using to build an army of drones to seize power.
